title: Future: select one, several or all authorized projects in shared views
description:
As a member working across projects, I want to select one, several or all authorized projects in shared Kanbus views so I can inspect my work without changing applications.

Feature: Future multi-project views
  Scenario: Select project scope
    Given a member with access to multiple projects in one tenant
    When the member selects one project, several projects or all authorized projects
    Then the board and filtered list show only that selected authorized scope
    And the member can choose all issue types or selected types within that scope
    And configured stage filtering, ordering and paging remain consistent
  Scenario: Keep unauthorized projects private
    Given projects outside the member's access
    When the member opens or changes the project selector
    Then unauthorized project records are not exposed
  Scenario: Preserve domain configuration
    Given selected projects with configured types and stage labels
    When the member navigates a shared view
    Then each issue retains its configured meaning and full identity
    And interactions use the same generic Kanbus contracts

Future capability: this story is backlog and is not part of the current single-project Prospectus proof. Backend and component choices should leave room for this behavior without claiming the UI is implemented.
